text.en:
There are hereby created in the municipality of Toledo, Province of Cebu, four barrios which
shall be known as General Climaco, Capitan Claudio, Kalongkalong, and General Del Rosario and shall
consist of the following sitios:
General Climaco: Makpak, Yogyugon, Pañgamihan, Tongkay, and Guingkiotan.
Capitan Claudio: Maypay, Cueva, and Maipis.
Kalongkalong: the present sitio of that name, which shall be segregated from the barrio of Matab-ang.
General Del Rosario: Bungdo, Masaba, and Ababa.
All Acts or parts of Acts inconsistent herewith Repealing clause, are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect in accordance with the provisions of section eleven of the
Administrative Code.
Approved, November 14, 1935.
